string.text: Reach the power plant\n\nBarkeep:"Everyone here just went crazy when they found out! Everyone who could started pushing towards the center of the Zone: loners, Freedom, Duty, even mercs. The one who gets there first will get everything! Wish granter, the klondike of artifacts, and the devil knows what else. Hurry up, if the Granter is indeed in the sarcophagus of the station, then the one who gets there first will get his wishes granted. Right now there's a detachment of veterans gathering in front of Pripyat. If you hurry, you'll be able to go with them."
